title: Understanding the Expectation
text: The expectation is taken over the randomness in the data. When we draw random samples from a population, each sample can be different, leading to different model outcomes.

title: Sources of Randomness
text: Consider the sources of randomness in the bias-variance tradeoff. One source is the randomness in the data due to sampling from a population.

title: Reason for Expectation
text: Why do we take an expectation in the bias-variance tradeoff? Is it because we draw random samples from a population?
